definition: No credentials, no real data. Replay-safe to observe. Not served from this repo; the reference surface is cpcp_demo.

registry.note: The method and seam registry this scope is read against, pinned by full SHA so the public contract resolves to exactly one revision. This repo publishes no public seam; the reference is here so a reader of the public contract can resolve the vocabulary it would be read against.

because: No seam in this repo is public. Everything here is pod-network or host-loopback. The reference public surface is the demo stub in cpcp_demo, which the contract map assigns to public_cpcp; this repo serves none of it.

exposure.note: A published port here is host loopback, never the open internet. That is pod_external_cpcp, not public.
exposure.evidence: Measured 2026-09-05 from the deployment files, per rule 4. runtimes/mind-pod/docker-compose.yml has ONE ports: entry -- line 98, service config, "13003:3000". runtimes/mind-pod/app/extract/compose.yml has three -- line 30 back "13002:3000", line 71 front "13000:3000", line 99 config "13003:3000". Every other service is expose-only. oxigraph binds 0.0.0.0:7878 (docker-compose.yml:156) INSIDE the pod network and has no ports: entry, so it is not host-published. No seam in this repo is served at any of them: config, back and front are application surfaces, not CPCP seams at the public scope. DISCREPANCY, recorded rather than smoothed over: none of those ports names a host interface, so Docker binds 0.0.0.0 and they are reachable from anywhere the host is, not only from the host. spec/scopes.md defines pod_external as "reachable from the host, never from the open internet". Making that true means binding 127.0.0.1 in the compose files; until then the measurement and the doctrine disagree, and the measurement is what is here.
